---
applyTo: "**/*.{tsx,jsx,css,scss,html,kt,kts,swift}"
---

Before changing UI, read `DESIGN.md`, `TASTE.md`, `docs/UI-AVATAR.md` and the relevant surface docs.

OSCAR UI should be minimal, technical, tactile and quietly expressive. Use one dominant focal idea per surface. Personality comes from the avatar, motion, timing and real system state rather than decorative AI tropes.

Avoid:

- generic AI SaaS dashboards;
- permanent chat sidebars as the primary IA;
- walls of rounded cards;
- glassmorphism/neon HUD styling;
- purple/blue AI gradients;
- sparkle icons as the intelligence symbol;
- fake telemetry or loading theatre;
- stretching one mobile composition into desktop.

Use native conventions, progressive disclosure, reduced-motion support and bounded visual verification before marking UI work complete.
